page.overview:
Who is DJ?

Devon Montegomery Johnston III, often referred to as DJ, is a minor character in Cars. He is a street DJ who likes to blast his music and is a member of the Import Racers.

From an early age, DJ, whose full name is Devon Montegomery Johnston III, was interested in all kinds of music. He had a voracious appetite for collecting records and was a gifted student at the nationally renowned East Coast Music Conservatory. One evening at a friend's party, Devon met a gentleman by the name of Wingo. An expert in paint and body modification, Wingo designed a custom paint job for Devon and a wicked sound system to match. Now going by the name DJ, Devon revels in his treble but never loses touch with his bass!

One night while driving on the interstate, the Tuner Cars notice a drowsy Mack and decide to prank him for their own amusement. DJ puts on Kenny G's Songbird to put Mack to sleep and laughs away at the sleeping truck alongside his gangmates until Snot Rod lets out an explosive sneeze, forcing them all to flee the scene and jolting Make awake up his brief nap.

DJ is later seen during the epilogue alongside the other Tuner Cars when they speed past Sheriff, who chases and eventually captures them. He then punishes the gang for their reckless actions by forcing them to use Bessie to repair a road.
